observations: notes_left L1-L3: the end of note 8 of p. 171.
body L8: «huius mari» is printed for huius maris; kept as printed.

body L16: the dash of «al–khazar» measures 4.4 pt, shorter than the long dash of «al–Lān» in the same line (5.2 pt) and longer than a hyphen (3.0 pt); it is transcribed as a long dash, as in the other Arabic words of the quotation.
body L18: «lambiat» is printed for lambat; kept as printed.
notes_left L6: the first word of the corrupt reading is printed without dots (ٮحرى), and the fā' of the second without its dot (ڡيه), as in the manuscripts.
notes_left L7: between «كانه» and «نهر» a small hooked mark with a dot stands above the line and a short upright stroke below it; they are not transcribed.
notes_left L12, L16-L17, notes_right L22: in the Persian words the gāf is printed as a kāf with three dots above (ڭ), the pe with three dots below (پ).
notes_left L22: «جـز» is printed with an elongation between its letters, kept as printed.
notes_right L22: two specks stand before the opening parenthesis after «Gardīzī»; they are not signs.

notes_left, notes_right: the notes are set in a slightly wider leading than on the other pages (11.86 pt against about 11.5 pt), and the lines with Arabic words are set further apart; the edition follows the measured spacing.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
